```plato
    // The von Mises equivalent stress: the single number whose value at yield
    // equals the uniaxial yield strength, and the reading a result plot is
    // normally coloured by. It ignores hydrostatic pressure, so a body squeezed
    // equally from every side reads zero however hard it is squeezed.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Von_Mises_yield_criterion)
    VonMisesStress(stress: StressState3D): Pressure
    {
        var s = stress.Matrix;
        var normal = (s.M11 - s.M22).Square + (s.M22 - s.M33).Square + (s.M33 - s.M11).Square;
        var shear = s.M12.Square + s.M23.Square + s.M13.Square;
        return Pressure((0.5 * normal + 3.0 * shear).Sqrt);
    }
```
